# uptimekuma_notification_notifery (Resource)

Notifery notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_notifery" "example" {
  name       = "Notifery Notifications"
  api_key    = "your-notifery-api-key"
  title      = "Uptime Kuma Alert"
  is_default = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_notifery" "with_group" {
  name       = "Notifery with Group"
  api_key    = "your-notifery-api-key"
  title      = "Uptime Kuma Alert"
  group      = "infrastructure"
  is_default = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: api_key_wo is never stored in plan
# or state. Change the matching *_wo_version whenever a secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_notifery" "write_only" {
  name = "Notifery with write-only secret"

  api_key_wo         = "your-notifery-api-key"
  api_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key for authentication with Notifery service. Stored in state; use `api_key_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `api_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) API key for authentication with Notifery service, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `api_key`; requires `api_key_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `api_key_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `api_key` until the next apply with `api_key_wo` set removes it from state.
- `api_key_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `api_key_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `api_key_wo`.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `group` (String) Notification group for organizing notifications
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `title` (String) Title of the notification

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
